answer: A central registry reserves 1,000 capacity slots for unique AI agents, where each persona binds to a pearl of reserved compute for task execution. A verifier audits the trellis of incoming requests to ensure no two identities share a slot. An honest agent pays 1 unit for access, whereas a sybil farm incurs 1,000 units to bypass this dune of security. If an audit uncovers duplicate traffic, the registry mandates total cancellation.
